prompt_one_liner: Propose deleting a confirmed meal (Confirm). Clears the nutrition file(s) and refreshes day totals — use for remove/undo, not macro corrections. Pass slug when several of one type exist.
side_effects: Renders a Confirm card listing the meal file(s) to remove
On Confirm, deletes data/nutrition/… meal markdown (timed, slot-only, or snack-2 style variants)
Rebuilds Central Node Status Nutrition from remaining meals that day
